title: Additions
body: The addition acknowledges and extends the style of the existing building, using its datum lines and visual vocabulary. The new scheme inverts the original, placing the visual weight on top and tying the two together by carrying the cornice through and up both structures.

Originally a bank, the building was later converted to a church. The addition had to project the strength of the bank structure while bringing more light into the interior, so a clerestory runs along the top. The original materials were reused, with selected blocks replaced by stained glass in a pattern spelling “Praise be the Lord” in Morse code.
